test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. More than 134,000 people have been evacuated to safe areas.

B. They are now far away from the volcano.

C. The volcano is expected to erupt within two days.

D. Mount Agung is a volcano on the popular tourist island of Bali in Indonesia.
solution:
The correct answer is '**DCAB**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
 
• **Sentence D** will be the first sentence because it is an introductory sentence telling us about **'Mount Agung'.**
 
• After it, **Sentence C** will be used because it further tells us about the expected eruption of the volcano in two days.
 
• **Sentence A **will be the next sentence because it is connected with the previous sentence as it tells us that more than '1,34,000' people have been evacuated to safe areas. (as the volcano is expected to erupt in 2 days)
 
• Lastly, **Sentence B** will be used.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **D**: Mount Agung is a volcano on the popular tourist island of Bali in Indonesia.
 
• **C**: The volcano is expected to erupt within two days.
 
• **A**: More than 134,000 people have been evacuated to safe areas.
 
• **B**: They are now far away from the volcano.

 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Mount Agung is a volcano on the popular tourist island of Bali in Indonesia. The volcano is expected to erupt within two days. More than 134,000 people have been evacuated to safe areas. They are now far away from the volcano.*
